about_the_game:
Story

The legendary staff "Honin Rod" that sealed away the Demon King.
However, due to the deterioration of the staff, the seal that lasted for many years has been broken.
The Demon King has been resurrected, and monsters known as "Gomono" have appeared, plunging the kingdom into chaos.

Yet, the king is indifferent to the suffering of his people!
As long as he can eat his beloved pudding, he's satisfied and shows no intention of dealing with the Demon King or the Gomono.

But then, all the pudding in the kingdom was stolen by the Demon King!
The king, who didn't care about the people's suffering, is now furious because he can't eat his favorite pudding.

He orders a search for the descendant of the Hero of Light who once sealed away the Demon King.
However, since he announced a reward for defeating the Demon King, countless people claiming to be descendants of the Hero of Light swarm the kingdom.

He promises to pay a reward to whoever defeats the Demon King first.

The protagonist, Buchi, faces a financial crisis because his father's pudding factory had its ingredients stolen by the Demon King.
To save his family's finances (albeit reluctantly), he sets out on a journey to defeat the Demon King.

What's Go?


You may have heard the name, but don’t really know what it is, and it sounds difficult.
This game is just for you!

The long-awaited Go Fantasy RPG is here!
Adorable and colorful characters. Stunning graphical effects.
Dress-up items. Battles with monsters.

All the essential elements of a fantasy RPG are packed into this game.

While enjoying the game, you will naturally learn how to play Go in this long-awaited masterpiece.

This is the first part of a two-chapter series.
In Chapter 1, you will learn the rules and basics, while the upcoming Chapter 2 (the final chapter) will provide more advanced tactics and lessons on the 19x19 board.
This series aims to teach you everything you need to know about Go, from knowing nothing to becoming a player.

Regarding Streaming

Streaming is allowed! Feel free to share your gameplay!
